mapper.select: SELECT FACTORY_CODE, YEAR, MONTH, MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, PRODUCTION_VERSION FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND PRODUCTION_VERSION != '' AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION != '' AND LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION != '' AND LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION != MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, YEAR, MONTH, MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, PRODUCTION_VERSION

SELECT fin.STRUCTURE_NAME, fin.STRUCTURE_TYPE, fin.MATERIAL_CODE, fin.MATERIAL_DESC, fin.EMBRYO_CODE, fin.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, fin.BRAND, fin.SPECIFICATIONS, fin.MAIN_PATTERN, fin.PRO_SIZE, fin.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, fin.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, fin.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, fin.ADJUST_QTY1, fin.ADJUST_QTY2, fin.ADJUST_QTY3, fin.ADJUST_QTY4, ddps.NET_QTY, ddps.HEIGHT_QTY, ddps.MID_QTY, ddps.CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY, ddps.CONVENTION_RESERVE_QTY, IFNULL(mar.TOTAL_QTY, fin.TOTAL_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY, IFNULL(mar.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY) AS HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, IFNULL(mar.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY) AS MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, IFNULL(mar.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY) AS CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, IFNULL(mar.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY) AS CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, IFNULL(mar.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY) AS POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, mar.IS_LOCK_SCHEDULE, IFNULL(mar.BEGIN_DAY, fin.BEGIN_DAY) AS BEGIN_DAY, IFNULL(mar.END_DAY, fin.END_DAY) AS END_DAY, IFNULL(mar.DAY_1, fin.DAY_1) AS DAY_1, IFNULL(mar.DAY_2, fin.DAY_2) AS DAY_2, IFNULL(mar.DAY_3, fin.DAY_3) AS DAY_3, IFNULL(mar.DAY_4, fin.DAY_4) AS DAY_4, IFNULL(mar.DAY_5, fin.DAY_5) AS DAY_5, IFNULL(mar.DAY_6, fin.DAY_6) AS DAY_6, IFNULL(mar.DAY_7, fin.DAY_7) AS DAY_7, IFNULL(mar.DAY_8, fin.DAY_8) AS DAY_8, IFNULL(mar.DAY_9, fin.DAY_9) AS DAY_9, IFNULL(mar.DAY_10, fin.DAY_10) AS DAY_10, IFNULL(mar.DAY_11, fin.DAY_11) AS DAY_11, IFNULL(mar.DAY_12, fin.DAY_12) AS DAY_12, IFNULL(mar.DAY_13, fin.DAY_13) AS DAY_13, IFNULL(mar.DAY_14, fin.DAY_14) AS DAY_14, IFNULL(mar.DAY_15, fin.DAY_15) AS DAY_15, IFNULL(mar.DAY_16, fin.DAY_16) AS DAY_16, IFNULL(mar.DAY_17, fin.DAY_17) AS DAY_17, IFNULL(mar.DAY_18, fin.DAY_18) AS DAY_18, IFNULL(mar.DAY_19, fin.DAY_19) AS DAY_19, IFNULL(mar.DAY_20, fin.DAY_20) AS DAY_20, IFNULL(mar.DAY_21, fin.DAY_21) AS DAY_21, IFNULL(mar.DAY_22, fin.DAY_22) AS DAY_22, IFNULL(mar.DAY_23, fin.DAY_23) AS DAY_23, IFNULL(mar.DAY_24, fin.DAY_24) AS DAY_24, IFNULL(mar.DAY_25, fin.DAY_25) AS DAY_25, IFNULL(mar.DAY_26, fin.DAY_26) AS DAY_26, IFNULL(mar.DAY_27, fin.DAY_27) AS DAY_27, IFNULL(mar.DAY_28, fin.DAY_28) AS DAY_28, IFNULL(mar.DAY_29, fin.DAY_29) AS DAY_29, IFNULL(mar.DAY_30, fin.DAY_30) AS DAY_30, IFNULL(mar.DAY_31, fin.DAY_31) AS DAY_31, mar.HAS_SPECIAL_MATERIAL, IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) AS MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION, fin.id
FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL fin
LEFT JOIN T_DP_DEMAND_PLAN_SUM ddps ON fin.FACTORY_CODE = ddps.FACTORY_CODE AND fin.`YEAR` = ddps.`YEAR` AND fin.`MONTH` = ddps.`MONTH` AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE = ddps.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) = ddps.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND ddps.IS_DELETE = 0
LEFT JOIN T_MP_ADJUST_RESULT mar ON fin.FACTORY_CODE = mar.FACTORY_CODE AND fin.`YEAR` = mar.`YEAR` AND fin.`MONTH` = mar.`MONTH` AND IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) = mar.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION = mar.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE = mar.MATERIAL_CODE AND mar.IS_DELETE = 0
WHERE fin.IS_DELETE = 0 AND fin.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND fin.`YEAR` = #{year} AND fin.`MONTH` = #{month} AND fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} AND fin.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = #{productTypeCode} AND fin.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = #{constructionStage} AND fin.BRAND = #{brand} AND fin.PRO_SIZE = #{proSize} AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%') AND fin.MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{materialDesc}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{mainMaterialDesc}, '%') AND fin.SPECIFICATIONS like CONCAT('%', #{specifications}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{mainPattern}, '%') AND fin.PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') AND fin.STRUCTURE_NAME like CONCAT('%', #{structureName}, '%') AND fin.CX_MACHINE_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{cxMachineCode}, '%')
ORDER BY STRUCTURE_NAME, MAIN_PATTERN, MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC
